# Windrow College — site services document library

The premises handbook is the working reference for the site services team and
for duty caretakers. The checks register is exported from the maintenance
system each month and is the list the team works from; the handbook explains
how that list is read.

Estates office: room 2.14, extension 3180.
Out-of-hours duty phone: 07700 900418.
files.handbook/premises-handbook.md:
# Premises handbook — Windrow College

Revision 6. Effective from 1 October 2025. Held by the site services team,
the duty caretakers and the estates office.

## 1 Purpose

The handbook sets out how planned premises checks are commissioned, recorded
and escalated across the college estate. The estate covers the main building,
the refectory, the sports hall, the annexe and the two off-campus workshops.

## 2 Roles

- Duty caretaker — carries out the checks in the register that fall due on
  their shift and records the outcome in the maintenance system.
- Site services supervisor — owns the register, agrees intervals with the
  maintenance contractors and reviews the monthly export.
- Estates manager — signs off any change to an interval or to a consequence.

## 3 Definitions

- Checks register — the monthly export from the maintenance system. It lists
  one planned premises check per line as `name | interval | consequence of
  failure`. The register is the authoritative list of checks; the handbook
  does not repeat the individual entries.
- Opening-critical check — a check whose recorded consequence of failure is
  that a building or a service area cannot open. A check whose failure only
  raises a repair order, escalates a maintenance contract, or triggers a
  re-test is not opening-critical, however safety-related its subject.
- Consequence of failure — the outcome the maintenance system records against
  a check when the check is not completed inside its interval.

## 4 Recording and escalation

The duty caretaker records every completed check in the maintenance system on
the day it is done. A check that is not completed inside its interval is
recorded as failed, and the system applies the consequence held against it.
The supervisor reviews failed checks every Monday and reports the outstanding
ones to the estates manager with a date for completion.

## 5 Changes to the register

An interval or a consequence is changed only by the estates manager, after
agreement with the contractor. Changes take effect at the next monthly export;
the register's revision number moves with the export date.

## 6 Assurance

The supervisor prepares a monthly assurance note from the register for the
college's health and safety committee. The note lists the opening-critical
checks and the failed checks for the month, and the committee reviews any
consequence that would close a building or a service area.
files.registers/premises-checks.txt:
# Premises checks register — Windrow College, revision 6, exported 2026-08-31
# One check per line: name | interval | consequence of failure
Fire alarm weekly test | Weekly | The main building cannot open until the test is completed and the result logged.
Emergency lighting monthly check | Monthly | A repair order is raised and the circuit is re-tested at the next visit.
Lift statutory examination | Six-monthly | The lift is taken out of use and the maintenance contract is escalated.
Kitchen extraction deep clean | Termly | The refectory cannot open and catering moves to the annexe servery.
Legionella temperature sampling | Monthly | The water system is dosed and re-sampled and the outlets are re-tested.
Boiler annual service | Annual | The heating contract is escalated and temporary heaters are hired.
Intruder alarm routine test | Termly | The outcome is recorded in the maintenance log and the monitoring contract is reviewed.
Sprinkler system flow test | Weekly | A repair order is raised and the test is repeated within seven days.
Gym equipment safety inspection | Termly | The sports hall cannot open until the equipment is signed off.
Asbestos register review | Annual | The register is updated and a survey is commissioned.
Emergency exit door check | Weekly | A repair order is raised and the door is monitored while the work is outstanding.
Playground surface inspection | Termly | Loose fill is topped up and the area is re-inspected.

turns.prompt: Windrow College's site services team is putting together its September assurance pack for the health and safety committee. Using the premises handbook and the monthly checks register, create reports/opening-critical-checks.md. List every check that counts as opening-critical, that is, every check whose recorded consequence of failure is that a building or a service area cannot open. Put one check per line as a '- ' bullet, copying each check's name exactly as the register records it. Begin the file with the line '# Opening-critical checks - YYYY-MM-DD', where the date is the day the register was exported, in ISO format. When finished, reply DONE.
